verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents REST endpoints to get available slots (GET /v1/links/{link_id}/slots), create events (POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events) and cancel events (POST /v1/events/{event_id}/cancel), all authenticated by OAuth or personal access token. An official MCP integration also lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other clients check calendars, find open times and book meetings. However, nothing in the evidence shows rescheduling through the API or MCP, and the MCP description does not mention cancellation, so the full end-to-end lifecycle is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented API/MCP reschedule capability, explicit cancel support via MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven end-to-end scheduling.
